name: io.github.motorical-smtp/motorical
title: Motorical
description: Send and track transactional email, manage Motor Blocks and domains, and run campaigns.

environmentVariables.name: MOTORICAL_MK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Motor Block key (mk_live_...), needed only to send over the local server. Not needed if you sign in with `npx @motorical/mcp login`.

environmentVariables.name: MOTORICAL_AK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Account key (ak_live_...) for the Public API tools. Not needed if you sign in with `npx @motorical/mcp login`.

environmentVariables.name: MOTORICAL_MOTOR_BLOCK_ID
environmentVariables.description: UUID of the Motor Block that block-scoped calls should use. Recommended when your account has more than one.

environmentVariables.name: MOTORICAL_DEFAULT_FROM
environmentVariables.description: Default From address for sends, on a domain verified in your account.
